title: Proper support of an individual etale module section
statement: Let $X,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $V\to X$ be an object of that site. Let $p:V\to S$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $s\in F(V)$. Say that $s$ has proper support over $S$ if there exists a closed subset $Z\subseteq V$ equal to the set of points $x$ admitting a geometric point $v:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$ with $v(*)=x$ [def-weil-geometric-point] such that the germ of $s$ in $F_{v\to X}$ is nonzero [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and $Z$ is proper over $S$ with its reduced induced closed subscheme structure [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base].
